identity.name: Submariner Date
identity.one_liner: The green-dial, green-bezel Submariner of 2010-2020 whose discontinuation pushed its market price far above the black model's.

narrative.story: Launched alongside the black 116610LN in 2010, the LV paired a green sunburst dial with a green Cerachrom bezel — the first all-green Submariner, following the green-bezel-only 'Kermit' 16610LV. Collectors named it the Hulk for the color and the heavy maxi case. When Rolex dropped it in 2020 without a direct all-green successor, secondary prices moved sharply upward and have stayed above the black model's since.
narrative.collector_notes: The dial shifts with light from deep green to near-black; photographs oversell the effect. Discontinuation made 2019-2020-carded full sets the sought-after configuration.
